title: Gravity and Vector
author: Sebastian Dravenmoor
blurb: Xanthe Thackeray, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
